cars.specification_market: Original Bugatti Type 43/43A production-road touring-sports family; selected 1929 Louwman Museum Type 43 touring-car reference. All six technical attributes map to the museum entry: eight cylinders, quoted 2.3 L, supercharger, three valves per cylinder, eight-spoke alloy wheels and steering-linked headlamps. Headlamp detail describes this collection car, not universal original equipment. No precise displacement, cylinder layout, horsepower, rpm, torque, gearbox specification, seats, weight, dimensions, measured acceleration or speed imported. Bugatti Trust curatorial text establishes public-sale sports-car identity; its different restored chassis 43208 supplies no selected technical fields. Group Type 43/43A engines, road bodies, years and chassis once. Dedicated Type 35/35B racers, the separately named Type 55 programme, modified Type 43/44 combinations and replicas are not additionally admitted. No race wins, swapped axles, racing fuel tank, unqualified first-100-mph priority, production totals or originality certification transferred.
cars.summary: The Bugatti Type 43 is a landmark early high-performance road tourer, combining a Grand Prix-derived supercharged engine with touring accommodation. The Bugatti Trust identifies it among the earliest very fast sports cars sold to the public, and its engineering and enduring sporting reputation justify admission beyond age or rarity. Count the original Type 43/43A road family once; other body styles, years and individual racing chassis do not add records.
